DIAGNOSIS
STEP 1. Check the power window sub-switch continuity.
(1) Remove the power window sub-switch. (Refer to P.42-71.)
(2) Check the continuity when the power window sub-switch is 
turned to the UP position or DOWN position.
Q: Is the power window sub-switch damaged?
YES : Replace it, then go to Step 3.
NO : Go to Step 2.
STEP 2. Check the harness wires between power window 
sub-switch connector E-05 and connector block connector 
C-95.
Q: Are there any damaged wires between power window 
sub-switch connector E-05 and connector block 
connector C-95?
YES : Repair them, then go to Step 3.
NO : Go to Step 3.
STEP 3. Check symptoms
Q: Can the power window sub-switch on the passenger's 
door open or close all door windows?
YES : This diagnosis is complete.
NO : Return to Step 1.
